enumDescriptions: Every cell runs in a new shell process.
Each runbook keeps one shell process per shell (bash, PowerShell), so `cd`, variables, functions and logins carry over between cells. cmd cells still run isolated.
mdRunbook.execution.mode.markdownDescription: How cells are run. `session` keeps one long-lived bash and PowerShell process per runbook, so state carries over between cells. See **md-runbook: Restart Session** / **Stop Session**.
